svg.title: tonmoycoder — contribution city
svg.desc: tonmoycoder's publicly visible GitHub calendar: 158 contributions across 21 active days, from 2025-11-02 to 2026-11-04. Each building is one day. Height is logarithmically scaled by contribution count; color follows the public calendar level. No activity is fabricated.
svg.text: One building = one day. Height is log-scaled activity, not code quality.
